sources.games: 666 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 54.1%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py kez.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Desolator, Mage Slayer.
sources.skills: Kez switches between two weapon stances that share his skill points, so a skill order cannot be read from the high-rank games (scripts/hero_item_stats.py: no ability is maxed first).

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Kez players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 36% of 89 games against them (10% otherwise), won 59% against 42%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 90% (2), power_treads 98% (6), pers 88% (10), mage_slayer 83% (12), yasha 36% (17), great_famango 22% (17), desolator 82% (17), manta 32% (20), black_king_bar 72% (24), ultimate_scepter 79% (26), lesser_crit 35% (31), butterfly 28% (31), greater_crit 29% (33), satanic 27% (38), swift_blink 26% (40), ultimate_scepter_2 27% (42).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 11500 (139 games, 89.2%), 25:00 15500 (154 games, 88.3%), 30:00 19500 (155 games, 85.2%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Valve 7.41f Echo Slash: an 800 line attacks every enemy in it twice. High-rank Kez players do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (55 games: it is not among the items they buy more often there).
suppress.break: High-rank Kez players rarely buy Silver Edge against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 11% of 36 games against them (2% otherwise), won 0% against 53% (a thin sample); Desolator and Mage Slayer are in his build.
